messages:
maria_support: Heads up — customer reports they were charged twice for their annual renewal and a PO payment landed at the same time. Customer sent screenshots showing two invoice numbers (INV-2026-031 and INV-2026-031-dup) and a credit card charge. They want an urgent reversal and confirmation for procurement.
jon_finance: got it. do we have the payment ids? ask for txn id and timestamp, and whether the PO and card were both processed by our system or a gateway retry.
maria_support: they provided gateway txn id: stripe_ch_3KXXXX and PO ref PO-4492. Charged on 2026-03-01 14:12 UTC and again 14:13 UTC. Customer says they only submitted the PO once.
ashley_billing: that looks like a webhook duplicate delivery or our retries hitting Stripe twice. i'll check our payment logs. tagging ops_bot to pull webhook retries.
ops_bot: webhook_log_search results for invoice INV-2026-031: POST /webhook 2026-03-01T14:12:05Z id=wb_abc123 status=200
POST /webhook 2026-03-01T14:13:07Z id=wb_def456 status=200
stripe_events: charge.succeeded x2, invoice.paid x2
jon_finance: if stripe has two charge.succeeded, we need to issue a full refund for the duplicate charge and create a credit note against the duplicate invoice. Do not void the original PO payment without confirmation from procurement — they may need a reversal doc.
maria_support: i messaged the customer asking for confirmation that they want the duplicate refunded to the card and a reversal notice to their procurement contact. they replied yes, refund to card + reversal email to procurement@acme.com
ashley_billing: preparing refund: stripe refund command: ```stripe refunds create --charge stripe_ch_3KXXXX --reason duplicate``` Will attach refund id here once complete.
ashley_billing: refund created: rf_1JXXXX amount=USD 12,000 status=processed. created credit_note CN-2026-031-DUP referencing INV-2026-031-dup. sending reversal notice now.
jon_finance: log the reversal in our ledger and mark invoice INV-2026-031-dup as reversed. i'll generate a reversal memo for procurement to sign if needed.
maria_support: 👍 customer confirmed they received the card refund and proc received reversal email. they asked for the refund confirmation PDF — attaching link to the refund receipt: https://dashboard.stripe.com/refunds/rf_1JXXXX
ashley_billing: added internal tag "double_charge-refund-2026-03" to the account and flagged for follow-up. Recommend we add a retry dedupe on webhook delivery for invoice creation events.
jon_finance: agree on dedupe. ops, can you open a ticket to add idempotency for invoice webhooks and gate duplicate invoice creation? put priority P1 for billing correctness.
ops_bot: ticket created: SYS-7782 "Webhook invoice dedupe & idempotency" assigned to eng-billing.
maria_support: thanks everyone. i'll close the loop with the customer and mark the support case resolved once procurement confirms the memo. :white_check_mark:
